obs.title: Adding an overlay to OBS
obs.step1: In OBS, under Sources, press + → Browser and give it a name.
obs.step2: Copy the URL above and paste it into URL. Leave "Local file" unchecked.
obs.step3: Enter the Width and Height shown above and press OK.
obs.reconnect: Leave OBS as it is when you restart KbmOverlay. The overlays reconnect within a few seconds.
relay.title: Two PCs
relay.intro: Run KbmOverlay on both PCs. On the streaming PC, OBS uses the same localhost URLs as with one PC. This PC:

combo.title: Keyboard + mouse
combo.intro: The keyboard, and the mouse with the movement ring around it, in one OBS source. To place them apart, use the separate overlays in the menu.
combo.hint: The ring lights up while the mouse moves and shows faintly while it is still, following Shown while not pressed. Raise the sensitivity if the light is too faint.
keyboard.title: Keyboard
picker.title: Keys to show
picker.intro: Click a key to turn it on or off. Only the keys that are on show in the overlay.
picker.listenHint: Press the keys to add on your keyboard, then press the button again. It stops by itself when you switch to another window.
picker.notOnBoard: {name} is not on this keyboard picture, so it cannot be added.

mouse.title: Mouse
mouseMove.title: Mouse movement
mouseMove.hint: Shows only while the mouse moves. Raise the sensitivity if it is too faint.
counter.title: Counter (KPS/CPS)
counter.hint: Counts the presses of the last second. KPS counts every key, CPS every mouse button.
history.title: Key history
history.only.combos: Only with Ctrl, Alt or Win
history.privacy: Shows what you type, letter by letter. Hide this source while typing passwords or private messages, or choose "Only with Ctrl, Alt or Win".
bars.title: Bars (rhythm game style)
bars.keys.osuMouse: Z X + left and right buttons
bars.keys.k7: S D F Space J K L (7 keys)
bars.listenHint: Press keys on the keyboard, or mouse buttons inside the box above. Press the button again when done; the lanes then go in keyboard order. It also stops when you switch to another window.
bars.noKeys: No keys yet. Add them with the button below.
bars.hint: With "Custom" in Keys, any keys and mouse buttons can be lanes.
footer.privacy: Key input is never saved or sent to the internet. Not an official OBS Studio program.
about.title: About
files.title: Editing the files
files.text: Colors, animations and key layouts can be changed in each overlay's menu. This is only for changing the look with CSS yourself, or adding your own keyboard layouts or a translation. The button makes a pages folder next to the exe, copies custom.css and the keyboard layouts into it (files already there are kept) and opens it. These files stay yours when KbmOverlay is updated.
files.copied: Copied {count} files and opened the folder: {dir}
files.failed: Could not make the folder ({error}). Move the exe to a folder you can write to, such as the desktop.
files.readme: How to edit them is explained in the README.
resetAll.title: Reset all settings
resetAll.text: Puts back everything this page remembers in this browser: options, colors, picked keys, the preview background, closed notices and the language. Two-PC settings stay, and sources already in OBS keep their URLs.
